description: Get float data for a company: floatShares, floatDefinition, as-of date, and — when the headline float is WITHHELD — the bounds and labelled stand-ins that replace it. Use when analyzing share supply. The share count the float was judged against (`basisSharesOutstanding`) is DATED: `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` ("stated" / "checked" / "none" = date not recorded) and a vendor-free `sharesOutstandingSource`; never present the count without its date. CARDINAL RULE: null / absent / withheld means NOT MEASURED — never "no float", never "no restricted shares", never zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and passes a null check, so decide from the reason/marker field ("floatWithheldReason", "restrictedBlockCount", "provenance", "direction"), never from the value alone. IMPORTANT: check "floatDefinition" to know which float you are reading — "tradeable" (shares outstanding minus affiliates minus restricted/unregistered blocks: what can actually reach the tape; used on filing-derived dilution-snapshot tickers), "non_affiliate" (the SEC I.B.6 figure, which INCLUDES restricted shares held by non-affiliates — not what a trader means by float), "non_affiliate_estimate" (approximated from ownership filings), or "free_float" (vendor methodology). TODAY "floatDefinition" and "source" are only present on dilution-snapshot results: a vendor-sourced float arrives with neither (just floatShares, asOfDate, floatEstimated) because vendors are not named — read an ABSENT floatDefinition as "not a filing-derived tradeable float" and do not assume it is tradeable. On snapshot tickers "nonAffiliateFloatShares" carries the SEC I.B.6 figure separately — it is the ONLY correct input to baby-shelf / I.B.6 shelf-capacity math; never use the tradeable float there, and never present the non-affiliate figure as tradeable supply. floatShares:null with "floatWithheldReason" set ("restricted_blocks_unnetted" | "stated_figure_impossible" | "affiliate_basis_stale" | "affiliate_figure_declined" | "affiliate_unreconciled" | "share_count_unavailable" | "split_post_dates_basis" | "split_unconfirmed" | "snapshot_float_unconfirmed" | "refusal_evaluation_failed") means the figure was deliberately WITHHELD by the snapshot AND no lower tier could answer — do not substitute a vendor float of your own. Since 2026-09-29 a snapshot that withheld its float FALLS THROUGH: when a lower tier can answer, "source" names that tier (computed / sec-10k / a market-data vendor tier), "floatShares" is ITS figure under ITS definition, and "snapshotFloatWithheldReason" carries the snapshot's reason as context ("the filing-derived snapshot could not state a float; showing <source>"). Read that field as provenance, never as a second refusal. 🔴 SINCE 2026-10-03 THE SNAPSHOT FIGURE ALWAYS HEADLINES: when the snapshot carries ANY figure — "floatEstimate" (bound "point" / "ceiling" / "floor"), "tradeableFloatCeiling", or an "affiliateBasis" range — "floatShares" stays null and THAT figure is the answer. 🔴 RENDERING RULE (2026-10-18): print NO "~", "<=" or ">=" glyph. A "point" (or a "floatEstimate" carrying "statedAsOf" {asOf, source, events[]}, the issuer's own dated count) is printed as the PLAIN number followed by "as of <asOf>" and the caveat (the unsized later issuances in "statedAsOf.events"); a "ceiling" / "floor" / range is NOT a figure — write "float not stated (the filings put it at most / at least N; <reason>)" and never the bare number. A lower tier that also answered and passed the guard rides "otherSourceFloat" {floatShares, source, provenance:"other_source", floatDefinition, asOfDate} as a SECONDARY "other source" line — never the float, never arithmetic. A lower tier fills "floatShares" ONLY when the snapshot carries no figure at all. 🔴 SINCE 2026-10-04 A TRIVIAL CEILING IS NOT A FIGURE: a snapshot ceiling ("tradeableFloatCeiling", a "floatEstimate" with bound "ceiling", or an upper-only "affiliateBasis" range) at or above 99% of the share count says only "the float is at most every issued share" and is STRIPPED from the response (null), so the lower tier may headline under its own "source" with "snapshotFloatWithheldReason" as context (e.g. a vendor figure of 5.12M, not "<= 11.18M" on 11.18M shares). Floors and point estimates are never stripped. EXCEPT (2026-10-08): a "floatEstimate" with rung "affiliate_sizing_estimate" carries a "reason" built from the filings' itemised insiders (e.g. "no reported insider holdings (4 affiliates at zero); 1 unreported: <name> (CFO, since <date>)") and "unsizedAffiliates" [{holder, role, since}]; it is KEPT even at the share count because the reason is a finding — quote the reason with the figure, and never present it as floatShares. A "shares_outstanding_ceiling" whose "reason" states a declared affiliate floor ("the insider holdings the filings size total at least N shares") may likewise be served at the share count, but ONLY as the last resort when no lower tier answered or its answer was refused (2026-10-11). 🔴 SUPERSEDED LATER ON 2026-10-11: EVERY "shares_outstanding_ceiling" now carries a "reason" (the declared floor, or "the filings do not size the insider holdings, so none are deducted") and HEADLINES even at the share count — a vendor figure then rides "otherSourceFloat" only. A "floatEstimate" may also carry "qualifier" (a short label — quote it with the figure, e.g. "insider holdings not sized") and "offBasis" (an array): "pre_split_as_filed" = the figure is AS OF "asOf", BEFORE the split(s) in "splitsAfter" [{ratio, effectiveDate, status}], NOT restated across them; "ordinary_shares_unconverted" = in ORDINARY shares on an ADS whose ratio is unresolved, NOT ADSs; "count_predates_issuances" = struck from a dated filing-cover count ("countSource") with later issuances not counted. An "offBasis" figure is true ONLY with its label: never compare it with a price, a market cap, another float or a threshold, and never state it without the label. Since 2026-10-01 that fall-through is GUARDED: a lower-tier figure dated before a split the snapshot names, or outside the snapshot's own floor / ceiling / point estimate, or (since 2026-10-08) COUNTED before share issuances the snapshot records totalling at least 10% of it, is REFUSED and the withheld envelope is served with "fallbackRefusal" {reason: "fallback_predates_split" | "fallback_predates_issuance" | "fallback_outside_snapshot_bounds", refusedSource, detail} beside the snapshot's "floatWithheldReason". The refused figure is NOT in the response and must not be fetched from a vendor to fill the gap — the detail says why no lower tier is shown either. A snapshot that stated a float never carries it. A withheld result may carry up to four stand-ins, each labelled IN the object; NONE is a float and NONE may be fed to a market cap, a percent-of-float, a short-interest ratio, a screen, a sort or a comparison: (1) "tradeableFloatCeiling" is an UPPER BOUND — the tradeable float is AT MOST this; render it with "<=" and nothing else (null = no bound stateable, never 0). (2) "affiliateBasis.floatLowerBound" / "floatUpperBound" are a RANGE the float lies in — "between X and Y"; each end is null independently when not measurable, so state the ends that exist as inequalities. They bound the NON-AFFILIATE float, which still INCLUDES restricted shares held by non-affiliates — NOT the tradeable floatShares. This object also appears on PUBLISHED floats; there it is context, never a bound on floatShares (a "convention_conservative" tradeable figure can sit BELOW floatLowerBound because it also deducts the restricted shares the bound includes — that is not a contradiction). (3) "floatEstimate" is a BADGED ESTIMATE {shares, basis, direction, confidence}: "basis" is the itemised working (quote it), "direction" says which way it errs ("overstates" = the true float is at most shares; "understates" = at least; "unknown"), "confidence" describes the estimate, not a float. Since 2026-09-29 it is the SNAPSHOT FLOAT LADDER figure on any withheld snapshot ticker and may also carry "rung" ("non_affiliate_estimate" | "shares_outstanding_ceiling" | "rolled_forward_lower_bound" | "recital_rolled_forward_estimate" | "successor_exchange_estimate" | "affiliate_sizing_estimate" | "form4_rolled_forward_estimate" (2026-10-18: the ownership table's D&O floor rolled forward by the insiders' own Form 4/5 transactions since the table date) | "best_estimate" (2026-10-18, founder: EVERY covered ticker shows ONE float number — the last rung: the MOST LIKELY figure when every filing-derived rung withheld; "basisKind" says what it rests on: rolled_forward_itemised | issuer_recital | declared_floor | affiliates_only_blocks_overlap | pre_split_derived | unconfirmed_split_excluded | vendor_float (with "vendorSource" / "vendorStale") | shares_outstanding_less_sized_affiliates | shares_outstanding; "assumptions" itemises every unsized holder and how it was treated, and "reason" opens "Estimate:" — report it AS an estimate with its assumptions, never as a measurement) | "restricted_block_ceiling" — since 2026-10-18 a POINT: O/S less affiliates, less the restricted blocks the filings place outside them and the part of the unplaced blocks too large to fit inside them, labelled "excludes N unregistered shares (<holders>)" in "reason"), "bound" ("point" = X as of "asOf"; "ceiling" = AT MOST X, render "<= X"; "floor" = AT LEAST X, render ">= X" — both only on payloads minted before 2026-10-18: the ladder now serves ONE dated point or nothing) and "asOf"; a floor or ceiling is a BOUND, never a point value. "statedAsOf" (when present) dates the point at the issuer's last stated count and lists later issuances NOT in it; "staleness" flags a point older than 12 months or one a known issuance post-dates. null means no figure could be derived from the snapshot's structured fields. An estimate never becomes floatShares — present shares WITH basis and direction, never alone. Unrelated to the boolean "floatEstimated", which flags a published floatShares back-derived from a USD public-float disclosure. (4) "vendorFallback" is a third-party free-float figure {floatShares, provenance:"vendor", floatDefinition:"free_float", asOfDate, splitAdjusted} offered beside the withhold — NOT our number, NOT on the tradeable definition, already refused when our filings refute it. Present it as the vendor free float as of its own date, never in the "Float" slot. "restrictedShares":null means NOT MEASURED (a block exists whose size the filings do not state), NEVER zero; "restrictedBlockCount":0 is an answer, not an absence. "affiliateBasisStale" (with basisSpanDays/affiliateAnchorDate) labels a float whose affiliate table is materially older than its share count — the number itself is unchanged. "tradeableBasis":"convention_conservative" means the filings did not answer and a published convention resolved it — see "tradeableConvention" and do not present the figure as exact.
